note: Synthetic forge standards checklist and per-agent compliance. Tune-ups fix standards without changing what the agent does.

standards.title: Tool contract
standards.check: Every tool has a docstring, type hints on every parameter and a return type, and returns a status ok/error dict.

standards.title: Secrets by reference
standards.check: Secrets are read from the environment (test pane) or Secret Manager references; never in code, prompts, tests or logs.

standards.title: Test coverage
standards.check: At least one test per tool and one acceptance test per acceptance criterion; the whole suite passes on every change.

standards.title: Pinned connector versions
standards.check: The agent pins each connector to a minor version (e.g. shopify_admin 1.4.x); upgrades are explicit modify jobs.

standards.title: Retries and backoff
standards.check: Connector calls retry 429/5xx up to 3 times with exponential backoff and a timeout on every call.

standards.title: Pagination to the end
standards.check: List calls follow pagination to the last page or a declared cap, and say when the cap was hit.

standards.title: Explicit time zone
standards.check: Dates are computed and shown in the client's declared time zone.

standards.title: Memory hygiene
standards.check: Memory keeps ids, timestamps and short summaries only - no raw email bodies or personal data - with 90-day retention.

standards.title: Structured, redacted logging
standards.check: Structured logs without secrets or full payloads; job prompts and logs pass secret redaction.

standards.title: Model from tier config
standards.check: No hard-coded model ids; the model comes from the forge tier configuration.

standards.title: Output contract
standards.check: A declared output format (schema or template) checked by an acceptance test.

standards.title: Side-effect guard
standards.check: Sends and writes to client systems run as drafts or dry runs in sandbox (DRY_RUN=true) and need explicit approval.

standards.title: Workspace as the signed-in user
standards.check: Google Workspace connectors act as the signed-in user via OAuth; no shared mailbox passwords or broad delegation.

standards.title: Plain-English errors
standards.check: User-facing errors are plain English and never include stack traces, tokens or raw payloads.
